changes.to: Issue #17 (2026-11-17): Walker S1 - 172 cm, 76 kg, 15 kg payload, 41 DoF and about 2 h are UBTECH's published figures. 0.83 m/s (3 km/h) is the walker speed UBTECH quotes for the S1 in its materials; UBTECH publishes no list price, so the HumanoidStore price was removed.

UBTECH's product page carries its specification panel as an image, so no machine-readable table is available. The figures recorded here are the ones UBTECH stated for Walker S1 at its October 2024 launch and at the BYD plant: 172 cm, 76 kg, and 15 kg carried while walking. Total DoF (catalogues list 41), speed (catalogues list 0.83 m/s), battery, runtime and IP rating are not stated in the maker's own announcement and are left empty.

changes.from: Full-size humanoid from UBTech Robotics; b2b only, sold to businesses.
